offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures skincare, over-the-counter sun care, and color cosmetics for beauty and personal care brands. It works directly with brands to formulate, produce, fill, and package finished products.

primary_services.value: custom formulation and product development; contract manufacturing; filling and packaging

customer_segment.value: B2B: beauty, skincare, and personal care brands

revenue_model.value: project or contract: formulation and production contracts for beauty brands; product sales: orders of finished products made to brand specifications

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: turns cosmetic ingredients and packaging materials into finished goods for beauty brands; service provider: develops custom formulas from product briefs supplied by beauty brands

geography_served.value: global: manufacturing operations in the United States and South Korea

specialization.value: related lines: skincare, sun care, and color cosmetics share formulation and manufacturing capabilities

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts and orders with beauty and personal care brands

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA cosmetics and over-the-counter sunscreen manufacturing, registration, and labeling requirements

notes: The full geographic footprint of its customer base is uncertain.
